summary: Mission run summaries and steps expose nullable lifecycle start and completion times in Unix milliseconds

replay.detail: Reads existing canonical timing claims; no replay change.

schema.detail: No storage migration. The client-v0 contract adds nullable started_at and completed_at fields.

compatibility.detail: Additive nullable client fields; completion is not moved by outcome edits. No ETA is provided.

recovery.detail: An older build omits the added fields; stored claims are unchanged.
